title: Schedule of Towing Benefits by Option, Cardinal Roadside Assistance
content:
The towing benefits of Cardinal Roadside Assistance differ by option in the tow distance paid, the destination the vehicle may be taken to and the ride credit after a tow. The remaining towing terms are the same on every option.

## Part A: Tow distance, destination and ride credit

| Option | Tow miles paid per service call | Tow destination | Tows paid per breakdown | Rideshare or taxi credit for the occupants after a covered tow |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Roadside Basic | 15 miles | Nearest qualified facility | 1 | $0.00 |
| Cardinal Roadside Standard | 25 miles | Nearest qualified facility | 1 | $0.00 |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus | 50 miles | Member's choice within the covered tow miles | 1 | $0.00 |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption | 50 miles | Member's choice within the covered tow miles | 1 | $0.00 |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier | 100 miles | Member's choice within the covered tow miles | 1 | $25.00 |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer | 100 miles | Member's choice within the covered tow miles | 1 | $40.00 |

Notes to Part A:

1. The tow miles figure is the tow distance paid on one service call.
2. "Nearest qualified facility" means the vehicle may be towed to the nearest qualified facility. "Member's choice within the covered tow miles" means the member chooses the destination, within the tow miles the option pays.
3. The ride credit is the most paid toward a rideshare or taxi for the occupants after a covered tow. Where the schedule shows $0.00, nothing is paid toward such a ride.

## Part B: Towing terms common to every option

| Term | Every Cardinal Roadside Assistance option |
|---|---|
| Storage of the vehicle after a tow | Not paid |
| Tow from a police impound or tow-away zone | Not covered |
| Recovery from off-road trails or bodies of water | Not covered |
| Tow from an accident scene paid under the vehicle's physical damage claim instead of using a service call | Yes |

## Worked comparison (hypothetical)

Suppose a vehicle needs a tow of 40 miles after one breakdown.

- Under Cardinal Roadside Standard the option pays 25 of those miles, and the vehicle goes to the nearest qualified facility.
- Under Cardinal Roadside Plus the option pays all 40 miles, since 40 is within the 50 miles paid, and the member may choose the destination within those 50 miles.
- Under either option, one tow is paid for that breakdown.

The 40-mile distance is an illustrative input, not a scheduled figure.
